SELECT id, content, article FROM passage WHERE content CONTAINS 'kill' OR content CONTAINS 'pull';
SELECT id, content FROM passage WHERE content CONTAINS 'benchmark' OR content CONTAINS 'retract' OR content CONTAINS 'kill' OR content CONTAINS 'pull' OR content CONTAINS 'legal';
